location_description: Ladera Heights is a community and unincorporated area in Los Angeles County, California. The population was 6,634 at the 2020 census.  Culver City lies to its west, the Baldwin Hills neighborhood to its north, the View Park-Windsor Hills community to its east, the Westchester neighborhood to its south and southwest and the city of Inglewood to its southeast.
